result.topic_en: Notes on the area element of a surface: rewriting the area integral using the Jacobian of two functions f, g as new independent variables, the difficulties this causes, and reducing the problem to determining a function of the complex variable so that boundary conditions are satisfied.

items.english: The actual introduction of f and g as independent variables causes difficulty and certain lengthy investigations when f and g both take the same values at several points of the surface or along a line, and is quite impossible when f and g are complex.
Accordingly the task is reduced to determining 𝔛 as a function of the complex quantity X, or 𝔛 as a function of d, so that the boundary conditions are satisfied.
